gen_risks.description: Insufficient funding for schools to deliver free breakfast clubs
gen_risks.mitigation: Conduct a thorough review of school funding needs and allocate additional resources as necessary

gen_risks.description: Difficulty in recruiting and retaining staff to deliver free breakfast clubs
gen_risks.mitigation: Provide training and support for staff, and consider offering incentives for recruitment and retention

gen_risks.description: Inability to deliver free breakfast clubs due to space constraints
gen_risks.mitigation: Conduct a thorough assessment of school facilities and identify potential solutions, such as using external providers or alternative venues

gen_risks.description: Delays in implementing the free breakfast clubs programme due to legislative or regulatory issues
gen_risks.mitigation: Engage with relevant stakeholders and monitor legislative developments to ensure timely implementation

gen_risks.description: Inequitable access to free breakfast clubs due to variations in school funding or resources
gen_risks.mitigation: Develop a fair and transparent funding model, and provide additional support to disadvantaged schools

gen_risks.description: Difficulty in engaging parents and carers in the free breakfast clubs programme
gen_risks.mitigation: Develop a communication strategy to raise awareness and encourage participation, and provide support for schools to engage with parents and carers
gen_risks.evidence: Evaluation plan: parent and school perspectives

gen_risks.description: Inability to measure the effectiveness of the free breakfast clubs programme due to inadequate evaluation methods
gen_risks.mitigation: Develop a robust evaluation strategy, including administrative data analysis, surveys, and qualitative research

gen_risks.description: Insufficient infrastructure to support the delivery of free breakfast clubs, such as equipment or technology
gen_risks.mitigation: Conduct an assessment of school infrastructure needs and provide additional resources or support as necessary

gen_risks.description: Difficulty in managing the transition from the National School Breakfast Programme to the free breakfast clubs programme
gen_risks.mitigation: Develop a transition plan, including communication with schools and stakeholders, and provide support for schools to adapt to the new programme
gen_risks.evidence: Commercial case: transition to FBC programme

gen_risks.description: Inability to address the needs of disadvantaged schools or pupils, such as those with high levels of food insecurity
gen_risks.mitigation: Develop targeted support for disadvantaged schools, including additional funding or resources, and monitor progress to ensure equitable outcomes
gen_risks.evidence: Strategic case: food insecurity and disadvantage

gen_risks.description: Delays or difficulties in procuring external providers or services to support the delivery of free breakfast clubs
gen_risks.mitigation: Develop a procurement strategy, including clear specifications and timelines, and engage with potential providers to ensure a smooth procurement process

gen_risks.description: Inability to ensure the quality and nutritional value of food provided in free breakfast clubs
gen_risks.mitigation: Develop guidelines and standards for food provision, and monitor compliance to ensure high-quality and nutritious food

gen_risks.description: Difficulty in managing the expectations and needs of different stakeholders, including schools, parents, and carers
gen_risks.mitigation: Develop a stakeholder engagement strategy, including communication and consultation, to ensure that needs and expectations are met

gen_risks.description: Inability to ensure the sustainability of the free breakfast clubs programme, including long-term funding and resource commitments
gen_risks.mitigation: Develop a long-term funding strategy, including potential sources of revenue and cost savings, and engage with stakeholders to ensure commitment to the programme

gen_risks.description: Difficulty in addressing potential issues or challenges that may arise during the implementation of the free breakfast clubs programme
gen_risks.mitigation: Develop a risk management strategy, including identification, assessment, and mitigation of potential risks, and establish a clear process for addressing issues or challenges
gen_risks.evidence: Risk and issue management: risk approach

gt_risks.description: Lower value for money compared to the 'do minimum' option in year 1, due to the shorter funding period available for the preferred option's new cohorts of schools.
Delivery risks around staffing and food costs for schools newly onboarded to the free breakfast clubs programme.
gt_risks.mitigation: Mitigated through early adopter (EA) scheme insights and support funding.

gt_risks.description: Uncertainty in the labour-market benefits (parental workforce participation gains) the programme is expected to deliver.
gt_risks.mitigation: Addressed through conservative assumptions in the economic modelling.
